methodologyNotes: Each vendor's official pricing page was re-verified via WebFetch on 2026-06-18: sellbrite.com/pricing-pro/ and sellbrite.com/pricing-power/, linnworks.com/pricing/, zentail.com/pricing, sellercloud.com/pricing/, and rithum.com (pricing page returns 404). Compliance pages were fetched directly: linnworks.com/security/, rithum.com/rithum-security/, rithum.com/gdpr-faq/. WebSearch was used to corroborate plan-level details. Corrections from the draft: (1) Sellbrite's pricing page has a monthly/annual billing toggle and the displayed prices ($29/$79/$179 etc.) are the standard MONTHLY rates, not annual-billing rates as the draft claimed; annual billing is CHEAPER (~17% off). monthlyUsd now records the published monthly rate. (2) The Sellbrite Shopify edition has lower platform-specific pricing (e.g. Pro 100 ~$19/mo) but is not a separate vendor; noted only. (3) Zentail 'pricing-zentail-launch' is not a real/separate plan page — removed; no 'Launch' tier exists. (4) Linnworks compliance source corrected to the live security page (linnworks.com/security/); the blog URL in the draft was not used. Zentail Base/Pro monthlyUsd are 'starting at' published floors on annual-contract-only billing (noted). Rithum and Linnworks lower tiers are quote-only so monthlyUsd is null. No vendors were fabricated; all five exist. accessedAt 2026-06-18.

vendors.name: Sellbrite
vendors.provenance: Plans and prices re-verified directly from sellbrite.com/pricing-pro/ and sellbrite.com/pricing-power/ on 2026-06-18. CORRECTION vs draft: the pricing page has a 'Monthly Billing / Annual Billing' toggle and the displayed prices ($29/$79/$179/$399/$699/$999/$1,699) are the standard MONTHLY rates; annual billing is cheaper (~17% off). monthlyUsd reflects the published monthly rate. Forever Free plan (up to 30 orders/mo) confirmed as a real forever-free tier. 14-day full-access free trial, no credit card.

plans.name: Forever Free
plans.notes: Up to 30 orders/month. Unlimited SKUs, unlimited sales channels, unlimited users. Sync every 2 hours. No FBA integration. Genuine forever-free plan, not a trial.

plans.name: Pro 100
plans.notes: Up to 100 orders/month. Unlimited SKUs, channels, users. 15-min sync. $29 is the standard MONTHLY rate; annual billing is ~17% cheaper. FBA Integration add-on +$19/mo. (Sellbrite-for-Shopify edition prices this tier lower, ~$19/mo.)

plans.name: Pro 500
plans.notes: Up to 500 orders/month. Unlimited SKUs, channels, users. 15-min sync. $79 is the standard MONTHLY rate; annual billing ~17% cheaper. FBA Integration add-on +$19/mo.

plans.name: Pro 2K
plans.notes: Up to 2,000 orders/month. Unlimited SKUs, channels, users. 15-min sync. Phone callback support. $179 is the standard MONTHLY rate; annual billing ~17% cheaper. FBA Integration add-on +$19/mo.

plans.name: Power 10K
plans.notes: Up to 10,000 orders/month. Unlimited SKUs, channels, users. One-on-one onboarding. API access. $399 is the standard MONTHLY rate; annual billing ~17% cheaper. FBA Integration add-on +$19/mo.

plans.name: Power 25K
plans.notes: Up to 25,000 orders/month. Unlimited SKUs, channels, users. API access. $699 is the standard MONTHLY rate; annual billing ~17% cheaper. FBA Integration add-on +$19/mo.

plans.name: Power 50K
plans.notes: Up to 50,000 orders/month. Unlimited SKUs, channels, users. API access. $999 is the standard MONTHLY rate; annual billing ~17% cheaper. FBA Integration add-on +$19/mo.

plans.name: Power 100K
plans.notes: Up to 100,000 orders/month. Unlimited SKUs, channels, users. API access. $1,699 is the standard MONTHLY rate; annual billing ~17% cheaper. FBA Integration add-on +$19/mo.

vendors.name: Linnworks
vendors.provenance: Pricing page re-fetched from linnworks.com/pricing/ on 2026-06-18 — confirmed quote-only, no dollar/pound amounts published; all plans require a custom quote with a one-time onboarding fee. Compliance re-verified from linnworks.com/security/ (corrected from draft's blog URL): ISO 27001 certified and GDPR compliant; no SOC 2 or HIPAA claimed.

plans.name: Linnworks Advanced
plans.notes: Connected commerce for complex fulfillment. Priced on order volume, not revenue. Modular add-ons (Listing, WMS, Enhanced Warehouse, Forecasting) carry additional monthly charges. Overages apply above the monthly order limit. One-time onboarding fee. Quote required — no published price.

plans.name: SkuVault Core
plans.notes: Streamlined warehouse inventory for growing retailers. Part of the Linnworks product family. Quote required — no published price.

vendors.name: Zentail
vendors.provenance: Pricing re-fetched from zentail.com/pricing on 2026-06-18. Three tiers: Base (starting at $300/mo), Pro (starting at $2,000/mo), Enterprise (contact us). Annual contracts only — FAQ explicitly states no monthly plans. 'Starting at' figures; final price is usage-based on annual sales across connected channels. CORRECTION vs draft: the second source URL 'zentail.com/pricing-zentail-launch' does not correspond to a real published page or a 'Launch' plan and has been removed.

plans.name: Base
plans.notes: 'Starting at $300/month', billed on an annual contract (no monthly billing). 100% usage-based — pay for listings and orders consumed; final price depends on annual sales volume. Core catalog, listing, and order management. Email and chat support.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: 'Starting at $2,000/month', billed on an annual contract. Volume discounts on usage, advanced automation and rules, priority support. Final price usage-based.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Custom pricing, annual contract. Large listing/order volumes, custom workflows, advanced permissions, SLAs, strategic account management. No published price — contact sales.

vendors.name: Descartes Sellercloud
vendors.provenance: Pricing re-fetched from sellercloud.com/pricing/ on 2026-06-18. Published starting price is $1,349/month on an annual subscription based on order volume, per-order fee model (no revenue share). Private Cloud and Enterprise Support are custom-quote. Per-order rate details corroborated by third-party reviews. No compliance certifications disclosed on the pricing page.

plans.notes: 'Starting at $1,349/month', billed annually based on order volume. Per-order fee model — no revenue share. Includes unlimited users, plugins, integrations, inventory/order/listing/shipping management, 24/7 emergency support, API access. Per-order rates reported ~$0.25/order at low volume declining toward ~$0.15/order at high volume (third-party). Exact tier needs a quote.
